Code 4 (Partially deployed) confirmed.

Definition: Does the government maintain a digital electoral register?
Comments: Partially deployed: Fichier Électoral Biométrique (FEB); detected 159k duplicates.
redteam_note: Scored >0 but NO source cited — unsupported claim, verify first.
revised_source_urls: [Code Electoral Niger](https://www.gouv.ne/images/textes-fondamentaux/codeelectoral.pdf); [Nigerinter - Remise fichier electoral biometrique (2 Sept 2020)](https://nigerinter.com/2020/09/02/processus-electoral-remise-officielle-du-premier-fichier-electoral-biometrique-du-niger-au-president-de-la-ceni/); [Le Point - Tiani investi president (26 Mar 2025)](https://www.lepoint.fr/afrique/au-niger-le-general-abdourahamane-tiani-investi-president-pour-au-moins-cinq-ans-26-03-2025-2585764_3826.php)
revision_notes: The Fichier Électoral Biométrique is a genuine national biometric voter database, legally established (Code Électoral arts. 36-46) and handed over to CENI in September 2020. However, since the July 2023 coup all elections have been suspended and political parties dissolved, with the transition extended to 2030 (Le Point, 26 March 2025); no evidence was found on whether CENI/DIFEB currently maintains or updates the FEB. Original code 4 is plausible for the pre-coup system but current operational status could not be confirmed — flagged for human review rather than asserted.
